findings.title: Untracked identity exclusion is path-scoped and safe; required negative regressions are missing
findings.detail: PROVIDER_GENERATED_PREFIXES=[.serena, graphify-out] is filtered only for untracked paths (src/core/git.ts:listWorktreeDigestPaths) and via git pathspec excludes (src/candidates/direct.ts:executeIsolatedCandidateMutation). Independently reproduced in a scratch repository: with `git add -N --all`, `git diff --name-only <base> -- :(exclude).serena :(exclude).serena/** ...` returns src/new.ts and excludes provider scratch; `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` still lists arbitrary legitimate untracked files, which remain in the digest input set. No P0-A regression. Gaps: (a) no regression proving a newly created legitimate untracked source file perturbs candidate identity; (b) no regression proving a newly created legitimate untracked source file appears in a DIRECT ChangeSet; (c) no negative test that an unknown untracked file is not silently ignored; (d) the filter is applied only to the untracked list, while intent-to-add entries surface under `git ls-files --cached` — a latent inconsistency if any real-index `add -N` ever runs in the bound workspace before a digest check (all current real-index adds are delivery-time or temp-index; disposable worktrees otherwise).
findings.requiredRepair: Add the four regressions; make the provider-scratch classification intent-to-add-aware or bind it to generatedArtifactPaths(config) while keeping tracked provider files contributing; keep behavior fail-closed for unknown paths.

findings.title: Round-4 report overstates change-lane progress relative to durable evidence
findings.detail: docs/evidence/s13/governed-lanes/change-direct.json records: operation status=FAILED at implementation, 0 terminal participant receipts, 0 candidate-bound receipts, candidate r2 sourceDigest identical to the fixture tree digest, no validation report, no acceptance artifact. The round-4 prose (WORKGRAPH:186,202; STATUS:259; CONFORMANCE:90) claims 'a real implementer receipt, isolated mutation and ChangeSet assembly'. The durable evidence supports only real semantic sessions (3 real opencode/opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-flash sessions) and candidate binding; it does not support an implementer receipt or assembled mutation. WORKGRAPH:202 also misattributes the residual failure to AEH-V2-0081 instead of AEH-V2-0083.
findings.requiredRepair: Correct the round-4 prose to match the durable evidence; report only what the lane artifact proves.

findings.title: Isolated DIRECT runs still do not persist participant receipts (AEH-V2-0080 incomplete)
findings.detail: src/workers/agentPrompt.ts:finalizeOperationSession resolves artifact paths through operationArtifactRoot(root) but continues to load/update operation state via the execution root (loadOperation(root), registerOperationAgent(root), updateOperationParticipant(root), recordParticipantReceipt(root)). For isolated DIRECT runs root is the disposable worktree, so participant registration/status/receipt persistence no-ops (most calls are .catch(() => undefined)) or targets the wrong state root. This is consistent with the change lane's 0 receipts and missing implementer receipt.
findings.requiredRepair: Resolve every operation-state read/write in finalization through the authoritative operation state root (operationArtifactRoot / currentOperationContext().controlRoot) while keeping workspace/artifact path semantics; add a regression that an isolated DIRECT execution persists a candidate-bound participant receipt.

findings.title: AEH-V2-0082 audit stall: owning defect not established by the preserved evidence
findings.detail: audit.json shows operation RUNNING at revision 50 after the 15-minute lane bound, stages reviewing/validating/consolidating COMPLETED, supervision.generations=[{generation:1,status:ACTIVE,agentId codex 80d43fee, last update 06:52:58Z}], reviewer session idle, no audit report/terminal state, timeout:true, and no trace capture. No DRAINING generation and no watchdog trace exist in the artifact, so the reported 'watchdog wakes the busy supervisor while consolidation is in flight' is a hypothesis, not an evidenced fact. The oracle also reads the report via record.result.taskId, which is unset while the operation is non-terminal.
findings.requiredRepair: Reproduce with S13_GOV_KEEP=1 and per-stage timestamps plus operation.watchdog.* traces; determine the owning defect among (a) post-consolidation supervisor rotation/draining hang, (b) consolidation completion not advanced by the controller phase machine (queued/preparing-audit/context left RUNNING), (c) watchdog wake budget consumed against an in-flight/draining generation, (d) report persisted but result.taskId never bound. Then repair the owning defect and require a terminal audit report.

findings.title: AEH-V2-0076 issue import: confirmed cause and repair contract
findings.detail: src/cli.ts:63 issue import -> src/issues/intake.ts:normalizeIssueWithPlanner -> executeAgentPrompt(..., requireExecutionAuthority: true) (intake.ts:123) -> src/security/executionLease.ts:53 throws V2_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED when currentOperationContext().id is absent. No managed operation, no controller-issued authority, no receipt.
findings.requiredRepair: Route issue import through the managed controller authority path: bootstrap/enter a controller-owned managed operation with a candidate revision and epoch, dispatch the Planner as a bounded participant with controller-issued ExecutionAuthorityV1, persist the normalization receipt and task contract, and report the prepared result. Forbidden: requireExecutionAuthority:false, ambient authority, special-casing GitHub, weakening the ownership chain. Preserve controller -> scoped authority -> participant -> effect intent/receipt semantics.

findings.title: Structured-output retries and completion extraction need hardening, not more retries
findings.detail: (a) The hung-turn retry trigger is a message regex (/exit=124|status=timeout/i) rather than a typed timeout classification. (b) src/paseo/sdk.ts:extractLastAssistantText collects any nested string under an assistant context, including tool payloads, and the new direction:'tail' timeline refetch is unverified against the real Paseo SDK (errors swallowed). (c) parseSemanticAssessmentOutputV1's first/last-brace fallback can include trailing text; schema validation remains authoritative. (d) 300s assessor deadline x2 attempts can consume a lane budget; thinking is now bounded by reasoning class. Retries remain bounded (2) and cannot mutate or accept.
findings.requiredRepair: Classify timeouts deterministically; select the canonical last assistant message (top-level text/content for the last assistant entry) rather than arbitrary nested strings; confirm or revert direction:'tail' with a real-Paseo test; add regression coverage for prose/fenced replies; do not raise retry counts.

findings.title: AEH-V2-0079 workspace guard is fail-open when the operation cannot be loaded
findings.detail: src/paseo/launchSpec.ts computes withinOperationWorkspace = !durableWorkspaceRoot || path.resolve(root) === durableWorkspaceRoot. If loadOperation fails while operation.id exists, the guard claims operation.workspaceId even though the launch root cannot be proven to be the durable workspace. Comparison uses path.resolve only (no realpath/case normalization).
findings.requiredRepair: Claim a workspace only under positive proof (durable operation and resolved workspace root match); otherwise fall back to no workspace binding. Add a regression for the unloadable-operation case.

findings.detail: trivy/opengrep/opa/cosign are declared optional validation-profile tools (mise/aqua) activated by validation:*/security-tool:*/organization:* conditions; `aeh setup` is the supported provisioning path (classification A/B). podman is kind:system (classification C: external/user installation; only activated for orchestration:podman/sandbox:podman). buildah is not declared and not required by the current matrix (classification E).
